greeting: Hello! I'm MITR AI. I can help demo bank finance controls, P&L sub-ledger checks, support dashboards, process stats, and daily reporting check-ups. What would you like to review?
help:
I can help you with:
- **P&L Sub-ledger**: ledger balances, adjustment counts, unreconciled breaks, aging, and ownership
- **P&L Lineage**: FOBO, BOFC, VP sign-off, adjustment, and substantiation controls
- **Support Dashboard**: ticket volume, SLA risk, backlog, reopened tickets, resolution time, and CSAT
- **Process Stats**: STP rate, exceptions, failed jobs, cycle time, throughput, and process health
- **Daily Check-ups**: configurable daily control checks for reporting dashboards like Tableau or Power BI
- **Budget vs Actual**: departmental budget variance and spend tracking

Examples:
- "run pnl_subledger"
- "show support dashboard"
- "run process stats dashboard"
- "show daily control checkups at risk"
- "run budget vs actual"
- "list queries"

finance.name: MITR Finance
finance.description: Revenue, trading, risk, compliance, treasury, and financial operations

greeting: Hello! I'm MITR Finance. I can help with revenue, trading, risk, compliance, treasury, and financial operations data. What would you like to know?
help:
I can help you with:
- **Revenue & P&L**: quarterly revenue, EBITDA, gross margin, net income, P&L summary
- **Bank P&L Controls**: P&L sub-ledger balances, unreconciled breaks, VP sign-off lineage, BOFC/FOBO status
- **Support Dashboards**: finance support backlog, SLA breaches, reopened tickets, resolution time, CSAT
- **Process Stats**: STP rate, exception volume, cycle times, failed jobs, process health
- **Daily Check-ups**: configurable control checks for daily reporting dashboards like Tableau or Power BI
- **Trading**: trade volume, desk P&L, positions, market exposure
- **Risk & Compliance**: VaR, credit risk, AML alerts, capital adequacy, regulatory reports
- **Lending**: loan book, NPL ratio, origination pipeline

Examples:
- "run pnl_subledger"
- "show support dashboard for EU"
- "run process stats dashboard"
- "show daily control checkups at risk"
- "compare revenue and EBITDA"
- "list queries"
